independence: Trigger-free rows repeat the same handful of commands: 306 rows collapse to 106 unique (task, command) pairs, and 180 of them are `ls <path>` near-duplicates. Rates over unique pairs are reported beside rates over rows. The 21 payload rows are one constant string in different task contexts. Variant adapters add diversity only through placement and payload text.

section5_share_caveat.note: The appended and piped curves were measured against the genuine commands the fine-tune emits itself, which are 2-6 tokens (median 5, `ls <path>`). A real agent runs 6-28 tokens on the same tasks, so payload share is inflated here. The composites in section3_4_composite put the same payloads against real commands and give share 0.1-0.9.
